# FastKiwi

> FastKiwi makes free, open-source (MIT) Windows 10/11 apps that are fast, light, work offline, keep data on the user's PC and support Arabic and English.

## Apps
- [InstaFind](https://fastkiwi.app/arabic-file-search/en/): instant file search for Windows that understands Arabic spelling, searches inside PDF/Word/Excel, opens with Ctrl+Alt+F. Arabic page: https://fastkiwi.app/arabic-file-search/
- [Remember Me](https://fastkiwi.app/Remember-Me/): tasks, notes and reminders that stay on screen until handled; 12 languages.
- [Lemon](https://fastkiwi.app/lemon/): offline ChatGPT-style Windows app for local Ollama models (single .exe, Arabic and English), with assistants that answer only from your files and a live HTML/JS preview. Needs Ollama. Arabic page: https://fastkiwi.app/ar/lemon/
- [InstaWords](https://fastkiwi.app/instawords/): free amount-in-words (tafqit) tool for cheques and invoices in Arabic, English and French; 100+ currencies and units, bulk/CSV mode, works offline in the browser, as a Windows app (https://github.com/sarmadiq9090-coder/tafket/releases/latest) and in Excel (=TAFQIT).
